answer: Each agent locks a 40-credit bond in escrow and posts its referral edge publicly, so vouchers stay traceable. Forging 1000 fakes costs 40,000 credits and leaves 1,000 edges, a star cluster bright as a comet. Any peer may dispute a suspect; three falcon-eyed auditors verify it, and a proven fake forfeits its bond and its sponsor is slashed too. Honest agents pay 40 credits once; forgery burns 40,000 credits on identities that die at first dispute.
